## [0.9.0](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0) (2026-11-10)
### Features
* the message list groups messages by conversation: a conversation is one row with its count, placed and dated by its newest message, and opens with the +/- box (the triangle on the Mac and Linux) or the Right and Left keys. View > Expand All Conversations and Collapse All Conversations do the whole list, and an action on a closed conversation acts on all of its messages. Tools > Options (Settings on the Mac, Preferences on Linux) turns it off ([fc9469e](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/fc9469e36ed39fc093bd19ed4cd43d2fe4e0cde2)) * Message > Watch Conversation (W) and Ignore Conversation (K): new mail in a watched conversation is always announced, new mail in an ignored one is marked read without a notification, and View > Hide Ignored Conversations takes them out of the list ([6f10659](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/6f10659dbd21a1b0ba376b2bc7dd9cf7998a57b6)) * bounces explained: a message that came back undelivered or delayed says for each address what went wrong, such as an address that does not exist or a full mailbox, and what you can do, with a link to the message that bounced. Bounces are marked in the list, and the search takes `is:bounce` ([f46d86b](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/f46d86b312d9e34211ebd339f0ec9ea325c1010e)) * the Address Book (Tools > Address Book): contacts and groups, Select Recipients behind the To, Cc and Bcc buttons of a new message, groups completed by name in the address fields, Add Sender to Address Book, and import from vCard and CSV and export to vCard in the File menu ([cf0d79f](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/cf0d79f92be1c2e102d8a19d609c1ece8c18ddf1)) * Archive, on the toolbar, in the Message menu and on the A key, moves messages into the account's Archive folder, made the first time when there is none. On Gmail it takes the labels off, leaving the message in All Mail. Undo puts them back ([95e8441](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/95e8441d9f9805378248570c75ada5fea735a99d)) * double-click a message, or press Enter, to open it in a window of its own, with Reply, Forward, Delete, Archive, Junk and Previous and Next through the list it came from ([5f6dba2](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/5f6dba2168e279a702cdc785dae293749faba94b)) * reading with the keyboard: Next and Previous Message, Next Unread Message (N) that goes on to the next folder with unread mail, Go to Folder, and Edit > Find in This Message ([93bbd11](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/93bbd115b4e97c8e310d73954e7338eb189c1558)) * Empty Folder, in the File menu and on the folder's right-click menu, empties Deleted Items and Junk E-mail for good, after asking ([fc6c39c](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/fc6c39cb32610d5b2aeaa35db0508c5c88f8f5aa)) * Sent Items and Drafts show whom each message went to in a To column, and the date column is titled Sent ([a1a010b](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/a1a010b56a5c6a5bb9ffec39137213277f231852)) * all of it in German, Estonian, French and Spanish too, the translations reviewed by native speakers ([851cef4](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/851cef4718467ea3c1b9cd09296dd04b9b80b8f9))
### Bug Fixes
* **windows:** the toolbar keeps its labels after the window is minimized and restored ([bec19ab](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/bec19abdb99a4b789a158a01c5ffb5fbc29ea26a)) * **mac:** the Folder column of a search no longer cuts off the Size column ([c2d5edc](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/c2d5edca045baeb17ebc3c03147aa660adafd4aa))
The Mac app installs this update itself (Inbox Classic > Check for Updates).

## [0.8.0](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0) (2026-11-07)
### Features
* Inbox Classic speaks German, Estonian, French and Spanish as well as English: the windows, the menus, the help and the Windows installer. It follows the system's language, and Tools > Options (Settings on the Mac, Preferences on Linux) lets you pick another one ([222d8d6](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/222d8d6ceb6b83ef4b33fcf7b24f742ab71fe22e), [5b2155a](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/5b2155ab7763fc4a66d01afaf10d30e4b5037f3c)) * select several messages with Shift or Ctrl (Cmd on the Mac), or all of them with Select All, and mark, flag, junk, move, delete, forward or save them all at once. Edit > Undo takes back the last move, delete or junk, however many messages it was ([03b6d72](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/03b6d7201f983d38eae30311ed1fd4b44d39326a)) * move and copy messages from one account to another, by dragging them onto a folder of the other account or with Move to Folder and Copy to Folder ([34ce542](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/34ce54208ca977020a91c7be0ef9c6eebea0aa1d)) * drag messages out of the list into a folder on your computer to save them as .eml files, and drag .eml files into a folder to put them there. Save As and Forward work on several messages at once ([177a837](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/177a837d91fff24faa50826fdbb02072df557d05)) * Message > Flag flags a message in a colour, the seven Apple Mail uses, so a colour set in either shows in the other ([fdade16](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/fdade1685857d065cf94e5dee046bc4e8634caa7)) * All Inboxes shows the mail of every account's Inbox in one list, and the app opens on the newest message ([4607c7f](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/4607c7f7537948ace9f3d9e662de662d0eaa28dc)) * the message list has no envelope column any more, so the subject gets the room ([1178459](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/1178459b29a99f00d8ce9971dd38b23c94a121a9))
The Mac app installs this update itself (Inbox Classic > Check for Updates).

## [0.7.0](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/compare/v0.6.0...v0.7.0) (2026-11-05)
### Features
* your own AI agent (Claude, Cursor or any other MCP client) can now search, read, sort and draft your mail. Inbox Classic asks you the first time a program connects, and you choose what it may do and which accounts it sees. Every message an agent wants to send is shown to you first, with every address spelled out, and waits 30 seconds in the Outbox once you say yes. Tools > AI Agents lists the programs and everything they did, with Undo. Agents get mail as text, without what a message hides from you. Tools > AI Agents > How to Connect an Agent shows the lines to add to your agent's settings ([#9](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/issues/9)) ([16abc1f](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/16abc1f3318eb9e2ee06da5288c8162d9e193db7)) * right-click a message for what can be done with it: reply, forward, mark read or unread, flag, junk, move, delete, save, print, its source or its properties ([#9](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/issues/9)) ([16abc1f](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/16abc1f3318eb9e2ee06da5288c8162d9e193db7)) * View > Message Source shows the whole message as the server keeps it (Ctrl+U on Windows and Linux) ([#9](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/issues/9)) ([16abc1f](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/16abc1f3318eb9e2ee06da5288c8162d9e193db7)) * a collapsed account or folder shows, in bold, the unread messages of the folders it hides ([#9](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/issues/9)) ([16abc1f](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/16abc1f3318eb9e2ee06da5288c8162d9e193db7))
The Mac app installs this update itself (Inbox Classic > Check for Updates).
